title: Over the Missing Road
concept: One insulated medicine crate rides a projected award through a working Alaska aviation network, then splits the proposal into cargo and passenger proof tracks before stopping at the first route the public record has not yet named.
palette: warm clinic cream spruce green berry red proof gold hopeful morning

fingerprint.palette: warm clinic cream spruce green berry red proof gold hopeful morning
fingerprint.metaphor: one medicine crate carrying two separate proof tickets over the missing road

angle.thesis: One preliminary award contains two tests, and Alaska should not confuse autonomous pharmaceutical cargo with a separate passenger and provider eVTOL proposal.
supporting_facts: No aircraft, route, approval, community agreement or completed flight is named
angle.fair_counterpoint: Existing Alaska aviation already moves medicine and people, so new aircraft must earn a useful place inside that network.
runner_up_angles: A geography mismatch investigation was too thin
A pure celebration outran the record
An air-taxi future story misused the autonomy claim

treatment.reasoning: The medicine cooler creates the strongest human-scale throughline and a cautiously hopeful emotional arc while keeping the proof burden visible.
grafts: five evidence lights mount on the crate
cargo ticket receives a WRONG TEST punch at the passenger gate

hook.frame1: A bright white medicine crate sits on the last plank of a spruce road as the roadway begins rolling away beneath it.
hook.headline: OVER THE MISSING ROAD
hook.loopback: The same crate and rolled road return, but the blank destination tag remains unresolved.

divergence_note: The September 10th film descended through a charcoal mountain cutaway with radar magenta and glacial cyan. September 6th lived in a dark marine blueprint around a hexagonal compute pod. This piece travels horizontally with a warm white medicine crate through cream paper, spruce terrain and plum proof gates, changing stages from road edge to award table to route map to a two-lane approval hall.

open_loop.what: What does one medicine crate have to prove before the missing road becomes a dependable route?

open_loop_2.what: Would a successful cargo test also prove passenger eVTOL?

throughline.lands_in_button: The future remains physically inside the unopened crate until one route is named and proved.

reveals.what: One company claim pulls back into 24 aircraft, eight hubs and more than 70 villages
The geography cards fold into separate cargo and passenger proof structures
Five outlined proof lights collapse into one blank route tag
